description: ACC target lateral distance (0x237 LAT_DIST) wrap: how often it occurs, where a wrapped target was published, and the replay of the acc profile with the check-byte unwrap against the same parser without it. LAT_DIST is the low 12 bits of the radar's 13-bit lateral distance; when the hidden bit is set the check byte's remainder is 0x14 (acc_check_bytes.json).

replay.what: fast suite: 278 six-segment chunks, 22.8 h, 16.9 moving h (27 replay drives, owner road, second car, fresh), unchanged pinned openpilot; the hand-decoded acc parser with and without the unwrap

source: research workspace SCR-950 (replay, unit check) and SCR-672 (wrap census)
